title: Check a supplier invoice before you pay it
context: You approve supplier invoices. Check each one against its purchase order and delivery record.

steps.question: Does the invoice match the order?
What do you do?
options: Hold it and ask the supplier for a corrected invoice

steps.reason: Same items, quantity and price as the order. Your company holds an invoice only when it differs from the order.
The record shows all 20 chairs. When items are missing and the invoice matches the order, your company pays for what arrived.
Both checks passed, so you pay the full $1,700.
